line: Bitcoin moves higher as sentiment stays greedy and futures funding warms, though spot ETF outflows continue and security breaches draw regulatory attention.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin +0.53% on the day, spot ETF net -82.4M USD (Oct 16, 2026), Fear & Greed 59 (greed), funding +0.0100% per 8h (warm)

wire_top3.line: Cysic halted its bridge after attacker minted 10M CYS tokens and moved $727K across Mayan, deBridge, and SWFT to Ethereum.
Turkish police arrested Hex founder Richard Heart and seized $7.15M cash, six cold wallets, and weapons across 15 addresses.
CFTC proposed a federal oversight framework for US crypto exchanges, potentially establishing unified licensing standards and consumer protections.
